newsitem.title: CHINA: China snowstorm halts flights, trains in northeast.
newsitem.headline: China snowstorm halts flights, trains in northeast.

text.p: A snowstorm that hit northeastern China's Liaoning province at the New Year delayed flights and halted trains and highway traffic, the Xinhua news agency said.

The snowstorm, which began on New Year's Eve and was reported to be the worst in three years, sent temperatures dropping to minus 17 Celsius (1.4 Fahrenheit), the official agency said in an overnight report.
Flights to and from Taoxian International Airport in the provincial capital of Shenyang were severely delayed, and heavy snow also disrupted flights to other northeastern cities, Xinhua said.
Railway traffic in Liaoning was affected but had returned to normal by Thursday evening, it said. It gave no details of whether provincial roads were still blocked.
